ports.note: Two ports, Table (`records`) and Polygon summaries (`polygons`), named the same on the canvas and in the Inspector (src/port-names.ts). The `series` port is retired: a workflow saved with it opens with the edge on Table and its inputMode removed (src/core.ts#migrateChartSeriesPort), and a case series on Table draws the same curve with the same receipt, its period and kind of date.

ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. The transmission tree asserts fw:TransmissionTree with its columns and counts, declared in ontology/runtime.ttl; listed here as none because this widget is defined in core.ts#TYPES, which the coupling check cannot attribute.

changes.description: Ports standardized (the practitioner, 2026-11-12: "Chart ports need to be standardized"; the node read Series, Records and Catchment polygons, the Inspector Case series, Table and Polygon summaries). Two ports, Table and Polygon summaries, named the same on the canvas and in the Inspector. The series port is retired into Table: a saved workflow opens with its case series on Table, drawn and receipted as before.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.8.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid. 0.13.0: tests/hagelloch-transmission-tree.browser.mjs and tests/hagelloch-chains-example.browser.mjs on Chromium. 0.14.1: tests/chart-panels.test.mjs (a blank panel drawn and named; 2, 9, 10 in number order) and tests/hagelloch-people-example.browser.mjs (ages 0 to 15, the gender-blank panel, 38 bars); Chromium. 0.15.0: tests/chart-panels.test.mjs (the line, band order), tests/transmission-tree.test.mjs and tests/relate-several.test.mjs (MERS: 162 cases, 2 with several sources, 3 further links). 0.15.1: tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (estimates with their intervals, points on a line, dots and bars each counted as drawn). 0.16.0: tests/chart-pyramid.test.mjs (the two sides signed, the youngest at the bottom, the blanks said, a column of three refused) and tests/hagelloch-people-example.browser.mjs (Hagelloch's pyramid, ages 0 to 15, 11 without gender said); Chromium. 0.17.0: tests/chart-pyramid.test.mjs (a date falls in the bin that holds it; drawn as a rule and its label) and tests/epidemic-curve.browser.mjs (Snow's curve marked, a second date added in Configure); Chromium. 0.18.0: tests/chart-pyramid.test.mjs (stacked, refused past six) and tests/hagelloch-people-example.browser.mjs (39 bars, 13 weeks by 3 classes); Chromium. 0.19.0: tests/chart-ports.test.mjs (two ports and their names; Snow's curve saved 2026-10-09 with the series port opens on Table with no mode) and tests/epidemic-curve.browser.mjs, tests/shared-chart.browser.mjs and the Hagelloch examples' tests; Chromium.
